# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map" "map" {
  name     = "example"
  comment  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the mapping table.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `hw_id` (Number) The index the mapping table occupies in the switch chip.
- `hw_offloaded` (Boolean) Whether the mapping table is programmed into the switch chip.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/ethernet/switch/qos/map get [print show-ids]]
```
